story: Police say a 57-year-old man allegedly fired several shots in the direction of an 18-year-old in Wilgehof, Bloemfontein, on the afternoon of Wednesday 21 October, but missed. Police say he then took his own life; paramedics declared him dead at the scene. No other injuries were reported. Police received a distress call at about 14:26, and an attempted murder case and an inquest docket are being opened. No one is named. One public report, resting on police: Radio Bloem, 21 October. The map point is a Wilgehof suburb point, not the property.
